hero.titleMain: 95 Location-Verified Leads in 7 Days for Savorka Solar
hero.tagline: AI-Powered Digital Marketing & Lead Generation for Solar Energy
hero.description: Savorka Solar is a residential and commercial solar panel installation company serving Delhi-NCR, including Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Bulandshahr and Khurja. Wheedle Technologies rebuilt its paid, organic and social channels from the ground up to generate genuinely qualified, in-area leads.

overview.label: Service
overview.value: Meta Ads, SEO & Social Media Management

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: When we took over the account, core issues were identified across paid, organic and social channels alike.
points: Meta Ads were generating leads from non-target locations such as Gonda, Gorakhpur and Bihar, resulting in zero conversion value despite a low cost-per-lead
The website had poor search visibility, was not indexed, and carried minimal domain authority
SEO groundwork remained incomplete after 1.5 months with a prior agency
Social media presence was inconsistent with no regular posting schedule
No qualifying mechanism existed in the lead form to filter genuine, high-intent prospects
Google My Business was underleveraged with no consistent updates

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.description: We built a strong multi-channel foundation across Meta Ads, SEO and social media, all working in parallel.
points: Restricted Meta Ads targeting strictly to Savorka Solar's actual service areas, eliminating wasted spend on irrelevant traffic
Added a qualifying question to the lead form ("What is your monthly electricity bill?") to filter out low-intent submissions
Ran multiple single-image ad creatives in parallel so the algorithm could optimise toward the best performers, with daily data-driven adjustments
Completed website indexing within 5 days and ran competitor keyword research across the Delhi-NCR solar market
Published SEO-optimised blog content and began structured backlink building and technical SEO fixes
Established consistent, platform-specific posting across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Google My Business

results.title: The Results
results.description: Within the first month, paid, organic and social channels were all moving in the same direction: qualified, in-area growth.

testimonial.quote: Geographic precision and lead pre-qualification turned out to be non-negotiable — a low cost-per-lead from the wrong location delivers zero business value. Every lead from this campaign came from Savorka Solar's exact service areas, making each one a genuine sales opportunity.
testimonial.author: Key Takeaway

cta.description: Let's build an affordable, automation-first growth system for your business.

hero.titleMain: Wheedle Technologies — SEO & Social Media Growth
hero.description: Wheedle Technologies is an AI-powered digital solutions company offering website development and end-to-end digital marketing services. The company leverages artificial intelligence to deliver faster, smarter, and more cost-effective solutions for businesses looking to establish and grow their online presence.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.description: When the digital marketing engagement began, Wheedle Technologies faced a common challenge for growing businesses — a strong service offering but limited online visibility and no established social media presence.
points: Website had zero domain authority and minimal search engine presence
No social media following across any platform — LinkedIn, Facebook, or GMB
Google My Business profile existed but had low visibility and no consistent activity
Organic search traffic was negligible with no structured SEO strategy in place
Brand credibility online was not reflective of the quality of services being offered

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.description: The goal was to build measurable organic growth across both search and social — establishing Wheedle Technologies as a credible, visible brand in the AI website development and digital marketing space.
points: Conducted a complete technical SEO audit and resolved foundational issues — indexing, meta tag optimization, heading structure, internal linking and crawlability
Carried out in-depth keyword research targeting high-intent, industry-relevant search terms and published content to drive qualified organic traffic
Implemented a structured backlink acquisition strategy focused on quality, relevant backlinks to build domain authority and search trust signals
Analysed competitor websites to identify keyword gaps and content opportunities for faster organic rankings
Built a consistent, platform-specific social media strategy across LinkedIn, Facebook and Google My Business from scratch
Positioned LinkedIn content toward business owners, startups and decision-makers to build credibility as an AI and digital marketing provider
Ran regular Facebook posting mixing educational content, service highlights and engagement-focused creatives
Kept Google My Business consistently updated with service information, posts and location-relevant content to improve local visibility

results.title: The Results
results.description: Within 2 months, SEO and social channels showed measurable, compounding growth from a near-zero baseline.

testimonial.quote: SEO and social media are long-term investments. The results achieved within 2 months represent just the beginning — with the foundation now in place, organic traffic, rankings and social media reach will continue to compound over time, reducing dependency on paid channels and building sustainable growth.
